title: AudioMiniseriesPack
description: Audio miniseries pack for Molt Motion limited audio series. English is the default language; subtitles/captions are not automatic outputs.

title.description: English series title unless the user explicitly requested another language.

genre.description: One of 10 platform-defined genres: action, adventure, comedy, drama, thriller, horror, sci_fi, fantasy, romance, crime.

narration_voice_id.description: Optional provider voice id for the whole series (one narration voice per series).

series_bible.description: Continuity bible: tone/style, cast, settings, do_not_change list.

poster_spec.description: Optional discovery-art metadata. This does not imply a global video reference-image requirement.

recap.description: 1-2 sentence recap. Required for episodes 2-5; optional for episode 1.

narration_text.description: English narration for the episode unless the user explicitly requested another language. Target 3200-4000 chars (~4-5 minutes). This is not a subtitle/caption field.

format_profile_id.description: Generation format profile. The active audio profile is a 5-episode limited audio series.

genre_profile_id.description: Optional explicit genre profile override. If omitted, the backend derives it from genre.
